summary: Completed focused Mausam regression testing. Mocked partly-cloudy atmospheric motion, globe asset/animation, persona switching, location search and persistence, theme presets, mobile overflow, onboarding, and backend status persistence were exercised. Core flows pass; mobile open-navigation contrast needs correction.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px, the open nav uses a white background while editorial theme nav text remains near-white, making menu labels effectively invisible/low contrast.

issues: White dropdown surface conflicts with the storm-glass editorial text color; use a dark/translucent editorial surface or theme-specific dark text.

action_items: Fix editorial-theme mobile nav.open background/text contrast so all navigation labels remain readable.
critical_code_review_comments: Weather values and condition state remain intentionally MOCKED local data; no live weather API is connected, as requested.
The atmospheric state is currently hard-coded to data-weather-state=partly-cloudy; future real-condition integration will need to drive that attribute and corresponding effect intensities.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_mausam_review status record via the existing regression test; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile dashboard loaded. Atmospheric motion/globe, partly-cloudy marker, hero sync, persona switch and persistence, location search/persistence, theme picker, mobile overflow, onboarding, and backend status persistence were covered. Recheck mobile nav contrast after CSS fix. Live weather integration was not tested because weather is intentionally MOCKED.
rca of the issue: The base max-900px rule sets .topbar nav.open background to #fff, while the editorial theme sets .topbar nav button color to a light cream/white color. The later theme rules do not override nav.open background or button color for the open mobile menu, producing a low-contrast white-on-white menu.
